limitations: External client app creation requires System Administrator permissions in Salesforce Setup.
Connected Apps must use PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) or client secrets; modern Salesforce instances mandate External Client Apps over legacy Connected Apps.

assumptions: Developer has access to a Salesforce Developer Edition org with System Administrator profile
Using OAuth 2.0 Web Server Flow with PKCE

externalWait.publishedRange: Instant activation (allow 2-10 minutes for global DNS replication across Salesforce login servers)

prerequisites.text: Salesforce Developer Edition or Sandbox org with System Administrator credentials

steps.title: Navigate to App Manager in Setup
steps.instructions: Log in to your Salesforce org. Click the gear icon in the top right > 'Setup'. In the Quick Find box on the left, type 'App Manager' and select it.
steps.completionCheck: Lightning Experience App Manager table appears.

steps.title: Create a New Connected App
steps.instructions: Click 'New Connected App' (or 'New External Client App'). Provide Connected App Name, API Name, and Contact Email.

steps.title: Enable OAuth Settings & Callback URL
steps.instructions: Check the box 'Enable OAuth Settings'. Enter your Callback URL (e.g. `https://app.example.com/api/auth/callback/salesforce`). Check 'Require PKCE' for enhanced security.
steps.completionCheck: OAuth settings enabled with valid callback URL.

steps.title: Select OAuth Scopes
steps.instructions: In Selected OAuth Scopes, move 'Manage user data via APIs (api)' and 'Perform requests at any time (refresh_token, offline_access)' from Available to Selected. Click 'Save' and then 'Continue'.
steps.completionCheck: Scopes saved; notice shows 2-10 minute replication delay.

steps.title: Retrieve Consumer Key and Consumer Secret
steps.instructions: Under 'API (Enable OAuth Settings)', click 'Manage Consumer Details'. Verify identity via SMS/email OTP. Copy the Consumer Key (Client ID) and Consumer Secret into your app configuration.
steps.completionCheck: Consumer key and secret copied to environment.

blockers.title: Propagation Delay on New Connected Apps
blockers.description: Salesforce takes between 2 to 10 minutes to replicate newly created Connected Apps across all global login clusters. Immediate OAuth requests may fail with 'invalid_client_id'.

blockers.title: IP Restrictions & Relax IP Settings
blockers.description: By default, Salesforce policies may enforce 'Enforce IP restrictions'. Under 'Manage' > 'Edit Policies', set 'IP Relaxation' to 'Relax IP restrictions' if your server environment uses dynamic IPs.

claims.text: Connected Apps and External Client Apps are the official mechanisms for integrating external applications with Salesforce via OAuth 2.0.
Salesforce supports PKCE (RFC 7636) and strongly recommends it for web server flows.
The 'refresh_token, offline_access' scope is required to obtain long-lived refresh tokens.
New Connected Apps can take 2 to 10 minutes to become active across all Salesforce authentication endpoints.

selectedPassages: A connected app integrates an application with Salesforce using APIs.
Allow 2-10 minutes for your changes to take effect on the server before trying to connect.
